summary: Design competency-led learning journeys, dashboards, and internal mobility plans. Build practical skills-based career pathways. Enquire today.
lede: Skills-based career pathways connect demonstrated capabilities with role progression, targeted learning and internal mobility. For learning and talent professionals, this course develops practical ways to map role competencies, identify skills gaps and design learning journeys tied to workforce needs. You will also practise using performance evidence and dashboards to support development, succession and mobility decisions, while accounting for governance and data limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage skills-based career pathways, connect learning to workforce capability, or support internal movement through evidence-based talent processes.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to learning and development, human resources, talent management, performance management, or line management. No coding or programming is required. You should bring one example of a role family, competency framework, learning programme, or career development challenge from your organization, with confidential employee data removed. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted skills inference and HR technology integration are taught at conceptual and operational application level, while dashboard exercises use provided sample data.
